RagShortTexts: Bruges connected Atlantic seafaring through the Zwin, serving as northern Europe's premier.

Variants.Content: Bruges reigned as the banking capital of northern Europe via its deep-water Zwin channel. Baltic Hanseatic timber and grain traded against Italian silks, spices, and bills of exchange beneath the watchful gaze of the municipal belfry.
Textile finishing guilds enforced rigorous inspection stamps, guaranteeing Bruges cloth unmatched commercial prestige across the continent.
